text: In Chicago, graduate student Helen Lyle studies the urban legend of Candyman, [a hook-handed spirit who comes when his name is said five times in a mirror|rules|calling it brings it]. Her research leads her to the Cabrini-Green housing project, where residents leave sweets for him and a recent murder is blamed on him. She learns he was [a painter, the son of a slave, killed by a lynch mob|origin|the wronged dead return] and stung to death by bees, and when Helen doubts him, he returns to [prove his legend in blood|wants|fame and worship].
